notes:
Design Engineering Tip: If text inside your container scales when the container animates, that's Motion's layout. It doesn't re-typeset the text - it scales it, like an image. <motion.div layout> <motion.p layout="position"> “Your Text” </motion.p> </motion.div>

Designer: @gabriell_lab. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
